Class JsonParser

java.lang.Object
parser.JsonParser
public final class JsonParser extends Object
Minimal, dependency-free JSON parser.

Converts a JSON text into a generic Java object tree:

  • JSON object → Map<String, Object>
  • JSON array → List<Object>
  • JSON string → String
  • JSON number → Double
  • true / false → Boolean
  • null → null

Single Responsibility: JSON syntax → generic tree. This class knows nothing about scenes, geometries, or colors — it only understands JSON grammar. Domain mapping is the job of SceneBuilder.
